description: A web page for troubleshooting and resetting/restoring a gateway device, including JavaScript functions for handling user interactions and AJAX calls for device management.

methods.name: setResetInfo
methods.description: Sends reset or restore commands to the device via AJAX, handles reboot and Wi-Fi restart processes.

methods.name: setBatteryInfo
methods.description: Sends battery reset information to the server via AJAX.

methods.name: checkForRebooting
methods.description: Checks if the device has rebooted by polling the index.php page.
